summary: xAI released version 1.19.0 of its Python SDK, adding parameters for image and video generation, a server-side image_generation tool, a tool_call_id fix for chat replay, and a default gRPC User-Agent string.

practices.reason: Developers using video/image generation or tool-call replay need to update to the new SDK parameters and behavior.
practices.quote: Add `reference_audios`, `generate_audio`, and 1080p to video generation by @Omar-V2 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/194

practices.reason: A new server-side image_generation tool changes how tool-calling pipelines could be structured, though no gain or usage detail is given.
practices.quote: Add image_generation server-side tool by @yanxi0830 in https://github.com/xai-org/xai-sdk-python/pull/186
